articles.title: Stocks Hit New Records Despite Jump in Oil Prices
articles.description: Wall Street appeared unworried about oil price surge. The S&P 500 rose 19.90 points, or 0.3%, to 7,599.96. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 46.42 points.
articles.content: Despite records being broken, a slight majority of US stocks actually fell, including companies with big fuel bills hurt by higher oil prices. United Airlines lost 2.6%, and Alaska Air Group fell 3.3%. [+2048 chars]

articles.title: Oil Prices Surge as Iran Talks Stall and Supply Concerns Return
articles.description: Oil prices moved higher after Iran suspended negotiations with the United States. Brent crude futures rose sharply amid concerns over Strait of Hormuz.
